note: Every weight here is a choice, not a measurement. agents.py weights-test scores the lab's own OOS trades with the code-only terms and prints expectancy by score quintile with intervals: that table is the only ground a weight stands on. The agent terms (fundamental, sentiment) have no history and carry no weight in the backtestable score. Long and short have separate vectors on purpose: a short is not the negation of a long.

rs_spy_20.why: relative strength over the market, one month

ma_structure.why: price over the 20 over the 50 over the 200

relvol_20.why: participation; capped so a spike is not momentum

lab_status.why: approved 1.0, watch 0.6, untested 0.3, rejected 0.0: the measured record first

oos_lower_bound.why: the conservative expectancy of the config out of sample

fresh.why: 1.0 when the entry bar closed at the cutoff or one bar before; a late entry is a different trade

mtf_agreement.why: the daily and weekly read agree with the side

long_opportunity.why: the record and the trend first; the catalyst last, since most days have none

short_opportunity.why: weakness is the mirror of the momentum terms, not its negation: a flat name is weak nowhere

catalyst.why: a catalyst with the side is worth something; one against it is a risk, not a score

confidence.why: evidence completeness x agreement x the record grade; capped at medium when a core source is missing or the regime is against
